name: sol10-caption-spacing
goal: Keep readable separators and same-side metadata in comparison viewer captions.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The existing catalog preflight at 5792693e42 fails EvidenceViewer captions and the EntityScreens viewer because Svelte trims whitespace at conditional text boundaries.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standard evidenceViewerActions separator assertion catches this migration defect, but only shared primitives were recorded before the broader catalog preflight. Preserve that assertion and add its visible caption check directly to the existing named catalog case.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Red 572286f5 at 53f140f6f1 fails the unchanged viewer consumer caption assertion; missing separator spaces are observed in rendered markup.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 033b33a002 preserves explicit separator spaces in EvidenceViewer without changing side labels, metadata, fixtures or assertions.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired green 0fa6c427 at 033b33a002 passes the same single standardized ComparePanes test, paired to red 572286f5 at 53f140f6f1 with identical command, test corpus and environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
